mapper.sql: id, tenant_id AS tenantId, course_code AS courseCode, title, term_start_date AS termStartDate, term_end_date AS termEndDate, description, location, instructor_id AS instructorId, state, archived_at AS archivedAt, creator_id AS creatorId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course ( tenant_id, course_code, title, term_start_date, term_end_date, description, location, instructor_id, state, archived_at, creator_id ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{courseCode}, #{title}, #{termStartDate}, #{termEndDate}, #{description}, #{location}, #{instructorId}, #{state}, #{archivedAt}, #{creatorId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET state = 'Active', archived_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: AND (course_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
